title: Conditional finite-to-population Ds bridge
statement: For i.i.d. samples from an atomless law with finite second moments and a uniform affine-slab margin, one-point exchange-stable finite Ds labelings satisfying mass, conditioning, and projected-centroid-separation margins are asymptotically geometric (vanishing disagreement with their own efficient-semimetric companion rule); subsequential limits are self-consistent, hence population-stationary, efficient-Voronoi quantizers with convergent values; global finite optima converge in value to the population optimum over the margin-compatible geometric class, attained by their limits. Without the separation margin the same conclusions hold for the reduced (merged) rule.
assumptions: S_i i.i.d., P atomless, E[S]=0, E||S||^2 finite, equal weights
uniform affine-slab margin: sup_{|v|=1,c} P(|v^T S - c| <= t) <= phi(t) -> 0
mass margin min_b W_b >= c0 > 0 along the sequence
conditioning margin lambda_min(I_q) >= kappa > 0 along the sequence
projected-centroid separation >= gamma > 0 (dropped in the merged-rule variant)
Lambda := 2 E||S||^2 bounds lambda_max(S_psi(I_N)) eventually a.s. (derived from (M1), not an extra assumption)

margins are assumed, not derived - and DS15 proves (M3) provably FAILS at free global optima for conditionally centered laws with d_psi = d_lambda = 1, so on that class the theorem governs margin-certified solutions at information cost delta(kappa) = v_K - v*(kappa) > 0 (OPEN-DS-MARGINS-AT-OPTIMA)
warning: Conditional theorem. DS15 (OPEN-DS-MARGINS-AT-OPTIMA, 29 Aug 2026) settles the margin question on the conditionally centered d_psi = d_lambda = 1 class (audited 30 Aug 2026; the d_lambda >= 2 generality of DS15 was refuted at K = d_lambda + 1 and is open at K >= d_lambda + 2): (M2) is automatic at global optima, but (M3) fails there for every kappa>0 - free global optima converge to the nuisance-degenerate efficient-score interval quantizer, so the bridge's hypothesis set is empty along them and DS14 governs margin-CERTIFIED (delta(kappa)-suboptimal) solutions instead. Beyond that class the margins remain open (OPEN-DS-MARGINS-NONCENTERED). Passed the publication-grade audit (AUDITS/AUDIT-DS-POPULATION-BRIDGE-001.md), which supplied the fixed-class slab Glivenko-Cantelli step, the derived Lambda, the explicit compact parameter set, and the merged-variant value identification.
role: the compile bridge candidate for profiled criteria
